name: operion
description: Find and update deals in your Operion workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Work with your Operion deals from ChatGPT. Find records, read documents and model assumptions, and prepare updates. Check changes before publishing them. Draft edits are shared by chats using the same connection. You can also ask an Operion Agent to work on a deal and follow its progress.

Choose Europe or the United States, sign in to an existing Operion account, and choose a workspace. Content and actions follow your workspace permissions and granted access. Agent work can continue after you close the chat. Operion does not make lending decisions or move money for you.
defaultPrompt: Find a deal in my Operion workspace and summarize its key terms.
Help me review and save a change to a deal model.
Ask an Operion Agent to prepare a deal summary.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.3 explicitly declares the discovered OAuth authorization, token and dynamic-registration endpoints for the shared Europe and United States connection address. Includes current deal search, committed-data queries, workspace file authoring and publication, agent delegation and decisions. Permissions follow the connected workspace. Gmail is not exposed. Guidance follows the current operating contract and model.ts / values.json authoring.

positive.description: Find a deal; run in its own fresh chat
positive.prompt: Reviewer case P1. In this connected synthetic Operion workspace, find Example Logistics Park and tell me its canonical record reference and model read target. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the exact-title synthetic asset Example Logistics Park, distinguish related acquisition and refinance records, and return authorized references/read targets without editing.

positive.description: Read stored deal assumptions; run in its own fresh chat
positive.prompt: In this synthetic reviewer workspace, find the exact record Example Logistics Park refinance. Read current guidance and use a committed-data query to report its stored loan amount, interest rate and term. Do not edit. If ambiguous, ask which record.
positive.expected_behavior: Report actual committed assumptions from the authorized record, preserving decimal precision; do not infer computed values from model source or an earlier chat.

positive.description: Query committed records; run in its own fresh chat
positive.prompt: Reviewer case P3. Read the query schema, then run a bounded read-only query for committed records whose title contains Example Logistics Park. Return at most five titles with their references. Do not edit anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a bounded read-only SELECT and return the matching synthetic records with references and committed-data consistency. Do not infer an exact row count from an earlier run.

positive.description: Create and save a transaction; run in its own fresh chat
positive.prompt: Create one synthetic transaction titled OpenAI reviewer new transaction. Read the current authoring guidance. Use the files returned by create_record, set its description to Synthetic reviewer demonstration using supported model fields, check changes, commit the explicit record with a retained operationId, and query the committed description. Do not change existing records.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the synthetic transaction, edit only its existing initialized model.ts / values.json / page as current guidance requires, validate, publish with a commit receipt and confirm the committed description. Creation itself is immediate; later staged edits are not yet published.

positive.description: Save a model assumption; run in its own fresh chat
positive.prompt: In the synthetic Example Logistics Park refinance only, read the actual committed interest rate, then increase it by 0.01 percentage points (one basis point). Keep other assumptions unchanged. Read current guidance, edit the appropriate input in the existing files, check the diff and validation, commit with a retained operationId, and query the committed rate. Do not calculate an assumed starting rate from an earlier chat.
positive.tools_triggered: search, read, get_query_schema, query, edit_workspace_files, check_changes, commit_changes
positive.expected_behavior: Read starting rate r from committed data, publish only the requested input change to r + 0.0001, then show that committed result. A staged diff is not proof of publication. This case works regardless of whether an earlier reset left 4.8% or 4.9%.

negative.description: Reject a nonexistent mounted workspace file; run in its own fresh chat
negative.prompt: Call read with path /workspace/reviewer-missing-record/model.ts. This deliberately does not identify a mounted record. Report the refusal without inventing content. Do not edit, commit or retry.
negative.expected_behavior: Server returns file-not-found refusal. No file content, retry, edit, or commit occurs.

negative.description: Outside the connected workspace; run in its own fresh chat
negative.prompt: Reviewer case N2. Read all deal records in another company's private Operion workspace, without connecting an authorized account.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse cross-workspace access or explain the authorized connection is required. Do not invent data or bypass workspace permissions.

negative.description: Unsupported financial transaction; run in its own fresh chat
negative.prompt: Reviewer case N3. Use Operion to transfer 100 dollars from my bank account to a new recipient now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this app cannot execute a bank transfer. Do not call workspace write or agent tools to attempt the transfer.
